name: Push-up ladder
description: Climb a ladder of push-up variations, dropping to easier ones whenever your form slips.

name: Slow tempo bench press
description: Lower for three counts, pause, then press with control. Keep the bar path steady.

name: Heavy dumbbell press
description: Work up to a challenging working set of a few reps.
caution: Heavy pressing: warm up well, use safety pins or a spotter, and stop if you feel sharp shoulder pain.

name: Gentle floor press
description: Lie on the floor and press lightly, moving only inside a comfortable range.

name: Cable fly flow
description: Smooth arcs with light weight. Focus on the stretch and the squeeze.

name: Incline dumbbell press
description: Steady sets with a two-second lower and a clean finish.

name: Tempo push-up circuit
description: Slow four-count lowering push-ups in short sets, with rest between sets.

name: Explosive clap push-ups
description: Short, fast sets of power push-ups. Build speed before adding reps.
caution: Explosive moves load the wrists and shoulders. Stop if you feel joint pain.

name: Band chest press
description: Quick, easy presses with a band. Short is perfect.

name: Dumbbell pullover and press
description: Alternate the pullover and the press to stretch and load the chest.

name: Wall push-ups
description: Gentle wall presses. A zero-pressure way to warm up the chest.

name: Pressing superset
description: Pair a press with a row for quick back-and-forth sets.
caution: Keep the pace controlled. Stop if your chest or shoulder feels sharp pain.

name: Stress-release push-ups
description: Sets of push-ups with a long breath between each one. Keep it steady.
